layout.tagline: Custock. Stock and customers in one place.
layout.linkFallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:
layout.followReason: You get this because you follow {{scope}}.
layout.accountReason: You get this email because of your Custock account.
layout.lowest30: Lowest price in the last 30 days: {{price}}

otp.subject: Your Custock code: {{code}}
otp.heading: Your sign in code
otp.lead: Enter this code to sign in to Custock. It works for 10 minutes.
otp.note: If you did not ask for it, you can ignore this email. Nobody can sign in without the code.

joinConfirm.subject: Confirm you want news from {{scope}}
joinConfirm.preheader: One tap and you will hear about new arrivals and offers.
joinConfirm.heading: Confirm your email
joinConfirm.lead: Tap the button to get news and offers from {{scope}}.
joinConfirm.note: If it was not you, ignore this email and nothing will be sent.

invite.subject: {{inviter}} invited you to {{org}} on Custock
invite.heading: Join {{org}}
invite.lead: {{inviter}} invited you to join {{org}} as {{role}} at {{scope}}. Accept to set your password and start.
invite.note: The link works for 7 days. If you did not expect it, you can ignore this email.

ownerInvite.subject: Your Custock is ready
ownerInvite.heading: {{org}} is ready
ownerInvite.lead: Your business is set up on Custock. Set your name and password to sign in as the owner, then invite your team.
ownerInvite.note: The link works for 14 days and only once. If you did not expect it, you can ignore this email.

changeCode.subject: Your code to change your email: {{code}}
changeCode.heading: Confirm your new email
changeCode.lead: Enter this code in Custock to confirm this is your new email. It works for 15 minutes.
changeCode.note: If you did not ask for it, ignore this email. Your email stays as it is.

emailChanged.subject: Your Custock email was changed
emailChanged.heading: Your email was changed
emailChanged.lead: The email on your Custock account is now {{email}}. From now on we write to that address.
emailChanged.note: If this was not you, reply to this email right away and we will lock the account.
emailChanged.button: This was not me, undo it
emailChanged.noteRevert: The button works for 7 days. It puts your old email back and signs everyone out of the account.

backInStock.subject: {{product}} is back at {{shop}}
backInStock.preheader: You asked us to tell you.
backInStock.heading: {{product}} is back
backInStock.lead: Good news, {{product}} is back in stock at {{shop}}.
backInStock.note: You get this once, because you asked to hear when it is back.

superadminInvite.subject: You are invited to run Custock
superadminInvite.preheader: {{inviter}} invited you as a super admin.
superadminInvite.heading: Become a super admin
superadminInvite.lead: {{inviter}} invited you as a super admin of Custock. Super admins see every business, create new ones and invite their owners.
superadminInvite.note: The link works for 7 days and only once. If you did not expect it, you can ignore this email.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your Custock password
passwordReset.heading: Choose a new password
passwordReset.lead: Someone asked to reset the password for {{email}} on Custock. Tap the button to choose a new one.
passwordReset.note: The link works for 30 minutes and only once. If you did not ask for it, ignore this email. Your password stays as it is.

passwordChanged.subject: Your Custock password was changed
passwordChanged.preheader: Every other device was signed out.
passwordChanged.heading: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.lead: The password for {{email}} was changed just now, and every other device was signed out.
passwordChanged.note: If this was not you, reset your password right away and reply to this email.

errorNotice.subject: New error in Custock: {{kind}}
errorNotice.heading: Something new went wrong
errorNotice.lead: A new error ({{kind}}) showed up in production. It is on the Errors screen with its details.
errorNotice.note: You get one email per new error, at most 10 a day. Repeats are only counted.
errorNotice.reason: You get this email because you are a super admin of Custock.

deleteCode.subject: Your code to delete your Custock account: {{code}}
deleteCode.heading: Confirm deleting your account
deleteCode.lead: Enter this code in Custock to delete your account. It works for 10 minutes.
deleteCode.note: If you did not ask for it, ignore this email. Nothing is deleted.

emailReverted.subject: Your Custock email is back
emailReverted.heading: Your email is back
emailReverted.lead: The email on your Custock account is {{email}} again, and every device was signed out.
emailReverted.note: If you also lost your password, ask for a new one on the sign in page.

transferSent.title: On the way to {{shop}}
transferSent.body_one: {{count}} item is on the way from {{from}}.
transferSent.body_other: {{count}} items are on the way from {{from}}.

approvalNeeded.title: A post is waiting for you

welcome.title: {{shop}}
welcome.body: Welcome. You will hear about new arrivals and offers here.

test.title: {{app}}
test.bodyStaff: Alerts work on this device. Low stock, deliveries and posts to approve will show up like this.
test.bodyCustomer: Notifications work. Offers and back in stock news will show up like this.

storage.title: Photo storage at {{percent}}%
storage.body: Of the free tier. New photos stop at 95%.

owner.title: {{org}} has its owner
owner.body: {{name}} set a password and can start.

budget.title: Email is waiting
budget.body: More than {{limit}} emails in an hour. The rest goes out next hour.

postScheduled.title: Your post is approved
postScheduled.body: "{{title}}" goes out at the time you set.

postReturned.title: Your post was not sent
postReturned.body: "{{title}}" was stopped before it went out.
